caps.text: Know when something happens in your city
caps.sub: Watch any place, in any country.

caps.text: Type a city and pick a distance
caps.sub: OSAP draws the circle for you.

caps.text: Save it, and OSAP keeps checking
caps.sub: Within minutes of new data, day and night.

caps.text: Something new inside it? You get an alert
caps.sub: On screen, or as a push alert on your phone.

caps.text: Every alert opens the report and its source
